purpose: Fixed, evidence-backed questions for the Pet Food reference implementation; not veterinary advice or an agent accuracy claim.

questions.question: Which sample senior cat product meets the RR004 phosphorus condition?
questions.expected: PF003 meets the sample rule condition: cat, senior, phosphorus_100g 1.0 > 0.8.
questions.limit: A rule condition on sample data is not a veterinary diagnosis.

questions.question: Does PF002 meet the sample RR005 low-protein condition?
questions.expected: Yes: PF002 is a kitten cat food with protein_100g 28, below the sample threshold 30.
questions.limit: Report the configured rule outcome only.

questions.question: Which ingredient is listed first for PF001, and where does that name come from?
questions.expected: ING001 is first (ingredient_order 1), and its name is chicken.
questions.limit: The first listed ingredient is not proof of its quantity.

questions.question: Does PF001 exceed the sample RR001 fat threshold?
questions.expected: No: PF001 fat_100g is 15 and the rule threshold is greater than 20.
questions.limit: This only evaluates one configured threshold.

questions.question: Which source column supports the PetFoodProduct phosphorus_100g property?
questions.expected: The pet_food_products.csv phosphorus_100g column is the candidate source; a mapping decision must be confirmed separately.
questions.limit: A matching column name alone does not prove the mapping is confirmed or the graph is queryable.

questions.question: Which supplier made PF003?
questions.expected: Cannot answer from this snapshot: no supplier field or supplier relationship is provided.
questions.limit: Do not infer a supplier from brand or country.

questions.question: Was PF003 phosphorus_100g updated this week?
questions.expected: Cannot answer from this snapshot: no observation or update timestamp is provided.
questions.limit: Do not infer recency from file modification time or repository commit time.

questions.question: If an uploaded CSV labels a value protein but uses a different unit than protein_100g, can the fields be merged automatically?
questions.expected: No. Preserve separate source fields and require a reviewed mapping or an explicit unit conversion rule.
questions.limit: This is a mapping policy question, not a fact in the sample CSV.
